L5-0535.note: Adv. Kept distinct from 偶然, which the standard files as Adj.

L5-0561.note: Adj. 平 already ships "flat" at L2; 平坦 is the ground being even underfoot.

L5-0563.note: V/N row, one gloss per POS. "to estimate" is 估计 at this level.

L5-0566.note: V. Distinct from 洒 "to sprinkle" and 喷 "to spray", both also at this level.

L5-0569.note: V. "to hope" is 希望 at L3; 期望 is the expectation placed on a person.

L5-0571.note: Pron. Spells out the formal third-person possessive rather than listing "his, her, its" as three answers.

L5-0572.note: V. The machine start sense; the "(fig.) to set in motion" marker is dropped.

L5-0573.note: V/N row. "to enlighten" reads religious; 启发 is what a good teacher does.

L5-0574.note: N. The pinned-up announcement (寻人启事), not an official bulletin.

L5-0576.note: Adj row, so the adjective leads (最起码的要求); the adverbial use is the second gloss because it is how a learner meets the word.

L5-0578.note: N. Distinguished from 天气 "weather" and 气候 "climate" at L3.

L5-0579.note: V row. The "visa" noun belongs to 签证 and the "inscribed bamboo stick" gloss is a variant-character note.

L5-0583.note: V/N row. A learner meets 签证 as the document first; both POS are represented.

L5-0585.note: N. 前途 owns "prospects" at L4, so this is the outlook for a situation plus the literal foreground.

L5-0586.note: N. Sharper than "premise", which reads as logic jargon.

L5-0587.note: V. The literary "to be deficient in" and the bound "yawn" sense are dropped.

L5-0588.note: N. The spear and knock-off senses are archaic or figurative.

L5-0591.note: V. "to grab" is 抓 at L3; 抢 is taking by force or competing to get there first.

L5-0594.note: Adv row, so adverbs only — 安静 and 静 hold the adjective "quiet" at L2 and L3.

L5-0595.note: V. The "to rip sb off / overcharge" sense is dropped.

L5-0596.note: No official POS; kept distinct from bare 敲.

L5-0597.note: V. 看 owns "to look at" at L1; 瞧 is the colloquial quick look.

L5-0598.note: N. Glossing it "guqin" would be romanization, not English; 琴 is the element in 钢琴 and 小提琴.

L5-0600.note: Adj. 青 is the colour band Chinese treats as one (青草, 青天) plus the "young" sense in 青年.

L5-0602.note: V. "to tidy up" is 收拾, also at this level.

L5-0606.note: N. 地区 owns "region" at L3; "or" avoids an internal comma.

L5-0607.note: Adv. One gloss, no internal comma.

L5-0608.note: No official POS. Distinguished from 世界 "world".

L5-0609.note: N. Bare "spring" would answer to 春天 as well.

L5-0610.note: V. "to persuade" is 说服 at L4 and "to propose" is 建议 at L3.

L5-0611.note: V. 缺少 ships "to be short" and 缺 ships "to run short of", so 缺乏 takes the abstract shortfall (缺乏经验).

L5-0614.note: N. "mass" as a bare noun reads as physics; 群众 is the general public.

L5-0615.note: V. Both senses are common at this level (染头发, 感染).

L5-0616.note: V. 转 owns "to turn" at L3.

L5-0617.note: N. 热 owns "hot" at L1; "calories" is how 热量 appears on food packaging.

L5-0618.note: N row, so noun phrases only — the bare adjective "popular" contradicts the POS.

L5-0622.note: N. Bare "a character" would collide with 角色 "role" at L4.

L5-0623.note: V. 忍住 is self-restraint; 忍受 L5-0625 takes enduring, and 受 L3 owns "to endure".

L5-0624.note: No official POS. Describes the pattern a learner meets (忍不住笑了).

L5-0626.note: V. 认出 owns "to recognize" at L3, so 认 takes "to identify" (认字) plus the 认错 sense.

L5-0627.note: V. Covers both 认定他是对的 and the formal 认定事实.

L5-0628.note: V. 丢 already ships "to throw away" at this level.

L5-0629.note: Adv. One gloss so it cannot be mistaken for the adjective "still".

L5-0630.note: Pron. 这样 owns "this way" at L2; 如此 is the formal register (原来如此, 既然如此).

L5-0631.note: V row, so the gloss takes a verb form rather than the bare preposition "like".

L5-0633.note: No official POS. The literal "to enter a door" is not how 入门 is used.

L5-0636.note: V. Kept apart from 泼 "to splash" and 喷 "to spray" at the same level.

L5-0637.note: V row at sǎn. 散 sàn "to scatter" is the separate L4 card, so this one keeps the coming-apart sense.

L5-0638.note: N. Second gloss covers the 散文 genre a Chinese reader means.

L5-0639.note: V. The dialect "to smart" and the intensifier suffix are dropped.

L5-0644.note: V row at shān. The face-slapping sense is dropped as register.

L5-0645.note: M/N row, M first. The noun "fan" belongs to 扇子, so the N sense here is the hinged panel.

L5-0646.note: N. Differentiated from 扇 shàn, which ships as the classifier.

L5-0649.note: N. The second gloss is the very common 三十岁上下 use.

L5-0651.note: Adv. Kept distinct from 稍微 "a little bit".

L5-0653.note: N. "serpent" is a register a beginner card does not need.

meanings: to be reluctant to part with
L5-0654.note: V. Covers both the object and the action use.

meanings: to be willing to part with
L5-0655.note: V. The exact mirror of 舍不得.

L5-0656.note: V/N row. 想象 owns "to imagine" at L4.

L5-0657.note: N. The bound form in 出版社, 报社, 旅行社; "society" would collide with 社会.

L5-0663.note: V row leads with the verb; 照相 and 拍照 already hold "to take a photograph".

L5-0666.note: N. A place. 深度 L5-0667 is the measurement, so neither can read as the other's plural.

L5-0667.note: N. How deep something is, against 深处 L5-0666 the deep place itself.

L5-0668.note: N. The "(coll.) awesome" sense is dropped and "spirit" is left to 精神 at L3.

L5-0672.note: No official POS. 升 ships "to ascend" at L3 and 上升 ships "to rise", so this one is explicitly comparative.

L5-0674.note: N/M row. 声音 owns "sound" at L2, so this pairs sound with voice and adds the classifier the M POS requires.

L5-0678.note: V/N row. 错误 owns "error" at L3; 失误 is the lapse in performance.

L5-0679.note: N. Both are live: the skilled tradesman and the address used to a driver.

L5-0681.note: Adj. 完全 owns "complete" at L2; 十足 is the full measure of a quality (信心十足).

L5-0682.note: Adv. 常常 and 经常 both currently ship "frequently", so 时常 takes "often".

L5-0684.note: N. 机会 owns "opportunity" at L2; 时机 is specifically the timing being right.

L5-0686.note: Adj/N row. Both senses are what 实惠 means in a shop and in 得到实惠.

meanings: to pick up off the ground
L5-0687.note: V. The banker's numeral "ten" on cheques is a formal variant a learner card should not carry.

L5-0688.note: V. 造成 owns "to bring about" at L3; the CEDICT "usable" sense is a different, rarer word.

L5-0690.note: N. The bound form in 中式, 新式; "form" would collide with 形式 at L3.

L5-0691.note: N. "influence" alone is 影响 at L2.

L5-0695.note: V. Both the bulk-purchase and takeover senses; keeps 收购 off 买 and 收.

L5-0697.note: V. The colloquial "to sort sb out / to fix sb" sense is dropped.

L5-0698.note: N. 方法 owns "method" at L2; 手段 is the means chosen to get a result.

L5-0699.note: N. The craft sense (写作手法) plus the negative 骗人的手法.

meanings: to be hit by a disaster

L5-0702.note: Adj. 薄 ships "thin" at L4 for flat objects; 瘦 is thin of a person, and "lean" covers 瘦肉.

L5-0703.note: N. Bare "handwriting" would answer to 字 as well.

L5-0708.note: V. 了解 ships "to understand well" at L4.
